comment: v0.2.6 source-package pin: the pak carries exactly the relative-import closure (verbatim .cp3 sources, exact folder structure) and nothing else. src/used.cp3 is imported (directly) by the entry, src/unused.cp3 is never imported and must not ship. There is no archive-inspect step in this runner, so the exact member list is a documented manual check (see README.md in this folder); the installed-tree assertions below are the harness-expressible proxy: install unpacks the members at their archive-relative paths, so an installed tree without src/unused.cp3 (and with src/main.cp3 + src/used.cp3) shows the closure was computed correctly. The paths assume the archive member names keep the package-relative folder structure (src/...), per the v0.2.6 change; if the landed layout differs, adjust only these three paths and keep the intent.
